title: Twitch Streamer
service:
Identity, merch, 3D stream scenes
emotes, subscriber badges
intro: A complete identity for a Twitch channel on its way to becoming a full-time job, from the logo to the emotes to fully 3D stream scenes. Retro-futurist nostalgia, built to feel sleek rather than dated.
brief: Tristan wanted a style rooted in his love of retro-futurism and vintage games, flexible enough to stretch from stream assets to merch. His initials, TYA, had to be in the logo, but not too obviously.
did: The logo runs through all three initials in a single continuous stroke. Turned vertical, it becomes a second, compact mark, and a motif taken from its curve ties the rest of the system together.

Because the channel lives on its community, much of the work went into what viewers carry around in chat. The subscriber badges grow from a single honeycomb cell to a full hive, so loyalty is something you can watch evolve, and the emotes give regulars a shared language of inside jokes and a reason to subscribe.
The starting, intermission and ending stream scenes combine 3D modelling with graphic design, so switching between games and activities feels smooth instead of abrupt.
